data.name: App.AdminRequired.Body
data.value: AETHER requires administrator rights. Approve the Windows UAC prompt when starting the application.

data.name: Desktop.Settings.BackgroundDescription
data.value: Read Windows events, devices, adapters, installed apps, and drivers every 30 minutes. The latest report remains local. No repairs are run. At Windows sign-in, checks run only if the separately approved AETHER startup task is configured.

data.name: Desktop.Settings.RestartNote
data.value: Saved appearance and language take effect only after a confirmed app restart. Windows Modern follows the Windows app color preference (AppsUseLightTheme).

data.name: Desktop.Settings.RestartPrompt
data.value: Your selection has been saved. Restart now to apply the appearance and language? Choosing Later leaves this session unchanged; the selection takes effect the next time the app starts.

data.name: Desktop.Settings.PreferenceSaved
data.value: Saved. The current session will not be restyled.

data.name: Desktop.Settings.SaveFailed

data.name: Desktop.Settings.GadgetHelp
data.value: Drag a gadget by its title. Position and opacity are saved. Minimize, restore, and exit using the AETHER icon by the clock.

data.name: Desktop.Settings.ChangesSaved
data.value: Changes are saved locally immediately. Configure or remove the startup task only through the installed setup.

data.name: Skin.ControlCenterHelp

data.name: Assistant.System.Scope
data.value: DISM component store and Windows system files / verification only

data.name: Assistant.System.NextSteps
data.value: Review the DISM and SFC completion messages. If corruption is reported, select DISM /RestoreHealth followed by SFC /scannow as separate, individually confirmed maintenance steps. Nothing starts automatically.

data.name: Assistant.Update.Scope
data.value: Update services, recent Windows Update events, and restart indicators / local

data.name: Assistant.Update.NextSteps
data.value: Review service status, restart indicators, and specific update events. A stopped service is not automatically faulty. Nothing is installed or started automatically; use the maintenance plan for another search if needed.

data.name: Assistant.Network.Scope
data.value: Local adapters, IP/DNS configuration, default gateway, and DNS resolution

data.name: Assistant.Network.NextSteps
data.value: Compare adapter status, address, gateway, and DNS output. A disconnected or virtual interface may be intentional. If there is a problem, first check the cable/Wi-Fi, router, and DNS configuration; AETHER does not reset adapters, IP, or DNS automatically.

data.name: Assistant.Devices.Scope
data.value: PnP problem codes and associated installed Windows drivers

data.name: Assistant.Devices.NextSteps
data.value: For a problem code, first check the device and code in Device Manager. Obtain a matching driver only through Windows Update or the official device manufacturer's website. AETHER does not automatically replace, remove, or install drivers.

data.name: Screensaver.ModernDisabled
data.value: The AETHER screensaver is disabled while Windows Modern is selected. Choose another appearance and restart AETHER to use the screensaver.

data.name: Safety.RestartNow.Body
data.value: The saved appearance and language are applied only after a restart. Restart AETHER now? Otherwise, the selection remains saved for the next launch.
